items.quote: The God of Abraham, and the God of Nahor, the God of their father, judge betwixt us.
items.claim: In Genesis 31:53, a speaker calls on the God of Abraham and the God of Nahor, described as 'the God of their father', to judge between the two parties.
items.object: the God of Abraham, the God of Nahor, the God of their father

items.quote: And Jacob sware by the fear of his father Isaac.
items.claim: Jacob swore an oath by 'the fear of his father Isaac'.
items.object: the fear of his father Isaac
